name: Mihai Popescu
bio:
Mihai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a childhood fascination with the intricate mechanics of Dacia automobiles. While his peers dreamt of becoming drivers, Mihai was captivated by the engineering beneath the hood. After graduating from the University of Bucharest with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he spent years honing his skills in local garages, modifying engines and fine-tuning suspension systems.

His meticulous approach to problem-solving quickly earned him a reputation for reliability and ingenuity. As technical director, Mihai believes in a collaborative approach, fostering open communication between departments to ensure that every decision is informed by a holistic understanding of the vehicle's performance. While his management skills are still developing, his loyalty and dedication to his team are unwavering. He strives to make his cars competitive, reliable and fun to watch.

Mihai's creative solutions and calm demeanor under pressure make him a valuable asset, particularly in challenging race conditions. While he is still entry-level, his methodical nature ensures that every detail is scrutinized, and his innovative ideas often lead to unexpected performance gains.

physical.description: A man of average height with a slightly weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn engineering handbook.
Has a habit of humming softly while deep in thought.
Insists on using only traditional tools for certain tasks.
